clue.text: Note smoker in pub is a musician

indicators.note: the note and the smoker sit within the word for a pub

parts.note: a bar is a pub or the counter in one
G is one of the musical notes A to G
a pipe is something one smokes

explanation.surface: A man puffing away in a pub turns out to be a musician.
explanation.definitionFit: A player of the Scottish pipes is one kind of musician, so the general word covers him as an example.

clue.text: A quail freaks out, seeing eagle

indicators.note: to freak out is to go wild, so these letters run wild into a new order

explanation.surface: A small game bird panics at the sight of a bird of prey.
explanation.definitionFit: Aquila is Latin for eagle and the name of the Eagle constellation.

clue.text: Quiet tear shed for father

parts.note: P is piano, the musical marking for quiet

indicators.note: shed is read as thrown off or scattered, telling us the word tear is jumbled

explanation.surface: A silent tear is cried over a dad.
explanation.definitionFit: Pater is the Latin word for a parent of the male line, used in old-fashioned British English for one's dad.

clue.text: Place some land projects in plan — use as revised

indicators.note: a revised plan has been reworked, so these letters are set out afresh

explanation.surface: Someone redrafting building plans on how to use land.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads 'place [where] some land projects': the dash is only a pause.
explanation.definitionFit: A promontory is a stretch of land that juts out into the sea, which is what projecting land means here.

clue.text: Responded to stimulus and created troubles

indicators.note: to trouble something is to disturb it, so the word created is stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone responded to a stimulus and made trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: To answer a prompt or stimulus with some response is the plain dictionary sense of the verb.

clue.text: Hitherto, why boys may telephone girls

definitions.meaning: a boy rings a girl in order to arrange a romantic outing with her

explanation.surface: Up to now, lads have called girls to ask them out.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means up till now, and read literally it is the purpose of asking someone out.

clue.text: Drinks given highest points

parts.note: top means highest, as in the top floor
E is east, one of the compass points
S is south, another compass point

explanation.surface: Drinks are awarded the top score.
explanation.definitionFit: To tope is to drink alcohol heavily, an old-fashioned verb; it drinks in the same third-person form.

clue.text: Perform for free?

definitions.meaning: to carry out a duty, as in discharging one's obligations
to release, as a prisoner or patient is let go

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether to do a show without a fee.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to carry out a duty and to release someone from custody.

clue.text: Having designs on one

parts.note: having designs on someone usually means scheming against them; here the designs are inked on the skin

explanation.surface: Someone is scheming against another person.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with ink pictures permanently marked on their body literally has designs on them.

clue.text: Mongrel dog sustained by meat

parts.note: a mutt is a mongrel dog
on as in living on something, kept going by it

explanation.surface: A mongrel kept alive on meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Mutton is the flesh of a sheep eaten as food.

clue.text: A quiet river location, well chosen

parts.note: P is piano, the musical marking for quiet
the Po is Italy's longest river
a site is a location

explanation.surface: A peaceful riverside spot, selected with care.
explanation.definitionFit: Apposite means fitting or apt, as remarks are when well chosen for the occasion.

clue.text: It's instrumental in having wine around

indicators.note: the wine is placed around the word in, enclosing it

parts.note: claret is red Bordeaux wine

explanation.surface: Wine plays a part in some event.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Instrumental' looks like 'helpful'; it means being a musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A woodwind instrument with a single reed, so it is literally something instrumental.

clue.text: It includes forms shown by group of fish

definitions.meaning: a place of education divided into forms, the British word for year groups or classes
a shoal of fish swimming together

explanation.surface: Fish shapes are displayed in a group.
explanation.definitionFit: Form is the British term for a class of pupils, and the word also names a large shoal of fish.

clue.text: It's responsible for a boom in flying

definitions.text: It's responsible for a boom in flying

parts.words: It's responsible for a boom in flying
parts.note: a boom in flying suggests air travel thriving; here it is the bang of a supersonic aircraft

explanation.surface: Something caused air travel to take off commercially.
explanation.definitionFit: Breaking the speed of sound causes a sonic boom, the loud bang heard from fast jets.

clue.text: It is rough, could be smoother

definitions.text: It is rough, could be smoother

parts.words: It is rough, could be smoother
parts.note: sounds like criticism of something unpolished; in fact the abrasive item is rough and is itself a smoother of wood

explanation.surface: A judgement that some work is rough and needs polish.
explanation.definitionFit: Abrasive paper is coarse to the touch and is used to make wood surfaces smooth.

clue.text: There's no alibi to put out for cancellation

indicators.note: put out is read as displaced or disordered, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A suspect has no alibi, so the charge cannot be dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: Abolishing a law or practice is doing away with it, a formal ending or annulment.

clue.text: Be prominent in project

definitions.meaning: to jut out from a surface

explanation.surface: Someone is told to shine in a project.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to be conspicuous and to protrude physically from something.

clue.text: Flag went up as a colourful garden feature

parts.note: a standard is a flag or banner
rose means went up

explanation.surface: A flag is raised as a bright decoration in a garden.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrub grafted onto a tall stem so its flowers bloom high up, a showy feature of gardens.

clue.text: Wastes rewards

definitions.meaning: barren expanses of sand, as in the Sahara
what one deserves, as in getting one's just ...

explanation.surface: Squandering what one has earned.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names arid wildernesses and, in the phrase just deserts, deserved punishments or rewards.

clue.text: Charm listener — first aim

indicators.note: first tells us the aim is placed ahead of the listener

parts.note: an end is an aim, as in ends and means
an ear is the organ one listens with

explanation.surface: Someone sets out to win over an audience.
explanation.definitionFit: To charm someone is to make them fond of you, which is to win affection.

clue.text: He aims to be unseen by the enemy

definitions.text: He aims to be unseen by the enemy

parts.words: He aims to be unseen by the enemy
parts.note: reads as someone trying to hide; aims is also literal, as he aims a rifle from cover

explanation.surface: A soldier hopes to stay hidden from the foe.
explanation.definitionFit: A concealed marksman who shoots at the enemy from a hidden position.

clue.text: Built with no one inside and demolished

indicators.note: with no says a letter is to go missing from the word
inside places the missing letter within the word rather than at an end

parts.note: raised means built, as a house is raised
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A building put up with nobody in it, then pulled down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no ... inside' takes I out of the middle of RAISED.
explanation.definitionFit: To rase, a variant of raze, is to level a building to the ground.

clue.text: Celebrate about rise that was given to recruits in the past

definitions.text: that was given to recruits in the past

indicators.note: about means around, so the word for celebrate goes around the rise

parts.note: to sing is to celebrate in song
a hill is a rise in the ground

explanation.surface: A party over a pay rise, the sort once handed to new soldiers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rise' suggests a pay rise but is the hill. Recruits to the British army once took the King's shilling, an old British coin worth twelve pence, as token of enlisting.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking the King's coin was the traditional sign of joining up, so recruits were given it.

clue.text: Inclined to have a fast round

indicators.note: the fast goes round the a, holding it inside

parts.note: Lent is the Christian period of fasting

explanation.surface: Someone tends to go on a quick lap.
explanation.definitionFit: Leant means sloped or tilted, the past of lean, as inclined is the past of incline.

clue.text: He works so that others may play

definitions.text: He works so that others may play

parts.words: He works so that others may play
parts.note: sounds like someone who labours for others' leisure; his works are pieces of music that others perform

explanation.surface: A selfless man toils so that others can enjoy themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who writes music produces works that performers then play.

clue.text: Formed pictures one thousand years old

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
aged as in aged ten, so many years old

explanation.surface: Images created a millennium ago.
explanation.definitionFit: To image something is to depict or picture it, so the past tense means produced pictures of it.

clue.text: Sorted, resorted and stocked

indicators.note: resorted is read as sorted again, so the letters of the first word are rearranged

explanation.surface: Goods were sorted, re-sorted and put on shelves.
explanation.definitionFit: Stocked goods are kept in reserve, laid away for later use in a warehouse or larder.

clue.text: A tray's in liquid to get clean

indicators.note: liquid means fluid and shifting, so these letters flow into a new order

parts.note: the possessive is taken letter for letter here, giving the S

explanation.surface: A tray is dunked in liquid to wash it.
explanation.definitionFit: Sanitary means hygienic, free from dirt and germs.
